name: Copper Piece
description: The lowest-denomination coin commonly minted in fantasy realms. 50 copper coins weigh 1 pound.

name: Silver Piece
description: The standard coin of common trade — a labourer might earn a silver or two per day. 1 sp = 10 cp.

name: Electrum Piece
description: An old coin of mixed silver and gold — rare in the modern realms but still found in ancient hoards. 1 ep = 50 cp.

name: Gold Piece
description: The standard for adventurers' wealth and treasure hoards. 1 gp = 100 cp = 10 sp.

name: Platinum Piece
description: The highest-denomination coin, used for very large transactions and noble exchanges. 1 pp = 10 gp = 1000 cp.
